args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (deployed to production) was failing health checks with an elevated error rate (18%). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated** checkout-api status and deployment history:
   - Current production version: **v2.3.1** — unhealthy, 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
   - Deployment history showed v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy in production; v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy.

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** (the most recent release that was healthy in production) in all regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action, which paged the on-call engineer for follow-up on root cause.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1-rc (staging) or any other version — the rollback went to the last verified-healthy production release as requested.
